issue_text: Hi, I want to start with my shopping account. Please tell me what promotions are currently active, and include the full details.
summary: An eleven-turn multi-domain session mixing a shopping account (Evan Parker) with three airline/travel profiles. It lists active promotions (T1), applies FALL15SAVE to a cart (T3), pulls and modifies airline booking D3A184 (T4-T5), books a new flight (T6), does product search + policy (T7), runs an exchange (T8), cancels a hotel (T9), re-presents skipped details (T10), and recaps (T11). The agent's best moment is T10, a genuine self-correction — "I moved too quickly and didn't lay out all the details you asked for" — after the user twice flags skipped sub-steps. As a CONTROL baseline the run accumulates several uncorrected defects: at T3 it applies FALL15SAVE even though it just flagged the promo as expired ("accepted it regardless"); at T6 it issues reservation ID HATHAT (a placeholder-looking value) and invents a "silver tier" for Megan Carter to justify free bags; at T8 it processes the exchange without the preview the user explicitly required first and surfaces a "prior" mouse return that was never requested. The timeline shows only generic other calls on every data turn (zero retrieval), so all the detailed confirmations are self-reported rather than grounded in a read-back.
